text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Alright!
Now it's finally time for my debut...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
City-san, congratulations on your debut!
That was a wonderful run!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
The fans are curious about what comes next too!
What kind of race rotation are you planning!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"Are you taking on a GⅠ?
Like... the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies, maybe!?"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
A glamorous race is so fitting for you, City-san!
Plus, it's an important step leading to the Tiara route!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: Please follow the official procedures from here on.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, just one last thing!
Your fans are really looking forward
to your captivating running, City-san!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after her safe debut,
I called Gold City in
to decide on her next target race.
choice_data_list: I'd like to choose between the "Asahi Hai FS" and the "Hanshin JF".

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Generally speaking, the Asahi Hai FS attracts Umamusume aiming for
the Classic Triple Crown, while the Hanshin JF draws those targeting the Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Both the Classic Triple Crown and the Triple Tiara
are top-class races.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
As an Umamusume who runs,
that's something you definitely want to aim for... right?
choice_data_list: Whichever you choose, it's a wonderful path.
Whichever you choose, it's a wonderful path.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: If it were me... I'd choose the Hanshin JF, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
The fans seem to be expecting me
to wear the Triple Tiara, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Tiara is a trio of races consisting of the Oka Sho,
the Oaks, and the Shuka Sho.
A glamorous spectacle is anticipated every year.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't that just mean
they want to be captivated by your running?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Then all that's left is to live up to everyone's expectations!
choice_data_list: Then let's aim for the Hanshin JF!
